ASAD-NOTES:15:75#n54/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:15:75#n54/r1.speaker: Zamakhshari and Razi
ASAD-NOTES:15:75#n54/r1.claim: Mutawassim denotes someone who studies a thing's outward appearance to understand its real nature and inner characteristics.
ASAD-NOTES:15:75#n54/r1.anchor: one who applies his mind to the study of the outward appearance of a thing with a view to understanding its real nature and its inner characteristics

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:15:75/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:15:75/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:15:75/r1.claim: The destruction of Lot’s people and the surviving ruins of Sodom are presented as lessons for humanity, especially for Quraysh, who should see the ruins and take warning.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:15:75/r1.anchor: Lût kavminin bu şekilde tarih sahnesinden silinmesi insanlık için birçok bakımdan ibrete değer olarak gösterilmekte

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:15:75/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:15:75/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:15:75/r2.claim: Meccan traders traveling to Syria would pass the remains of Sodom in Palestine, where Lot’s people had lived.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:15:75/r2.anchor: ticaretle meşgul olan Mekkeliler, Suriye topraklarına yaptıkları ticarî seyahatleri sırasında Lût kavminin yaşadığı Filistin’deki Sodom kentinden artakalan izleri görüyorlardı.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:15:75/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:15:75/r3.speaker: Muhammed Esed
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:15:75/r3.claim: Esed says aerial photographs remarkably confirmed an old route from northern Hijaz northward along the Dead Sea’s eastern shore toward Syria, with Sodom and Gomorrah to the northeast.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:15:75/r3.anchor: Muhammed Esed’in kaydettiğine göre (II, 524), “Kuzeydoğusunda Sodom ve Gomore bulunan Ölüdeniz’in kıyısını izleyerek kuzeye, Suriye’ye doğru uzanan Kuzey Hicaz’daki bu yolun varlığı

BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r1.claim: The signs include Lot’s people’s attempted assault on Abraham’s guests, the overturning of the city, and stones falling on the city and its absentees.
BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r1.anchor: أي فيما ذكر من القصة من تعرض قوم لوط لضيف إبراهيم طمعا فيهم وقلب المدينة

BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r2.claim: The “perceptive” are reflective people who scrutinize a thing’s marks until they recognize its reality and inward nature; the term connotes physiognomic insight.
BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r2.anchor: أي : المتفكرين المتفرسين الذين يبسطون في نظرهم حتى يعرفوا حقيقة الشيء وباطنه بسمته

BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r4.claim: The visible ruins are a great sign for believers, who know punishment followed wrongdoing; others explain them as chance or astrological configurations. The singular “sign” refers to the remaining traces alone, unlike the whole story previously described.
BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r4.anchor: لآية عظيمة للمؤمنين بالله ورسوله فإنهم الذين يعرفون أن ما حاق بهم من العذاب

BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r6.speaker: النبي عليه السلام
BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r6.claim: A prophetic report says earlier nations had inspired people who received impressions from the higher realm and spoke correctly by intuition; this is a high rank among saints, and Umar is the foremost example in this community, with the conditional wording emphasizing his distinction rather than expressing doubt.
BURSEVI:v4p319#3/r6.anchor: وفي الحديث : إن كان فيما مضى قلبكم من الأمم محدثون المحدث بفتح الدال المشددة

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.claim: The Lot account is historical evidence for the Quraysh, who passed the settlement; those wishing to see angels should prepare for the same fate.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.anchor: if they desire to see angels, then they should also get ready to meet the fate of the people of Lot

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.claim: Tawassum means observing something closely and drawing a lesson from it as an example.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.anchor: means to minutely observe and learn a lesson from something exemplary.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.claim: Quraysh are urged to learn from ruined nations, whose remains they pass on trade routes; Sodom and Gomorrah lay on the Hijaz–Syria route.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.anchor: They actually observe their remnants on the trade-routes they often pass by. It may be kept in mind that the settlements of Sodom and Gamorrah were situated on the trade routes of Ḥijāz and Syria.

ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p349#4/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p349#4/r1.speaker: قتادة
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p349#4/r1.claim: Qatada glosses al-mutawassimin as those who take warning or learn a lesson.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p349#4/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله تعالى ﴿ للمتوسمين ﴾ قال للمعتبرين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r17.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r17.speaker: مقاتل وابن زيد
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r17.claim: Muqatil and Ibn Zayd interpret المتوسمين as reflective people.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r17.anchor: وقال مقاتل وابن زيد: للمتوسمين، للمتفكرين.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r19.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r19.speaker: الشاعر
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r19.claim: An anonymous line from ʿUkaz uses يتوسم for consulting the group’s observer, supporting the sense of discerning signs.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r19.anchor: أو كلما وردت عكاظ قبيلة ... بعثوا إلى عريفهم يتوسم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r20.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r20.speaker: أبو عبيدة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r20.claim: Abu Ubayda glosses المتوسمين as people with insight.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r21.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r21.speaker: قتادة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r21.claim: Qatada glosses المتوسمين as people who take warning and learn lessons.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r22.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r22.speaker: نهشل عن ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r22.claim: A report from Nahshal transmitting Ibn Abbas says the verse means people of righteousness and goodness.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v6p490/r22.anchor: وروي نهشل عن ابن عباس للمتوسمين قال: لأهل الصلاح والخير

QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r7.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r7.speaker: في التفسير
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r7.claim: The exegetical gloss for “those who discern” is “the people of spiritual insight.”

QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r8.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r8.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r8.claim: Firasah is an inward perception that, when a proof appears, is not opposed by contrary evidence and draws from the heart what its possessor perceives.
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r8.anchor: والفراسة خاطر يحصل من غير أن يعارضه ما يخالفه

QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r9.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r9.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r9.claim: The word is related to a lion’s prey because the person of insight masters what is hidden.
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r9.anchor: مشتق من فريسة الأسد إذ لفريسته يقهر

QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r10.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r10.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r10.claim: God reveals to His friends matters hidden from other people.
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r10.anchor: والحق - سبحانه - يطلع أولئاءه على ما خفي

QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r11.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r11.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r11.claim: Spiritual insight is not guaranteed in every matter or at every moment; its perception may be blocked even for prophets.
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r11.anchor: وصاحب الفراسة لا يكون بشرط التفرس في جميع الأشياء وفي جميع الأوقات

QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r12.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r12.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r12.claim: During the slander against Aisha, the Prophet told her that if she had done it, she should repent to God.
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r12.anchor: كان يقول لعائشة - رضي الله عنها -

QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r13.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r13.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r13.claim: Abraham and Lot did not recognize that their visitors were messengers.
QUSHAYRI:v2p142/r13.anchor: وكإبراهيم ولوط - عليهما السلام - لم يعرفا الرسل

ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r1.claim: “In that” points to the story just recounted, which contains signs pointing to the truth.
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r1.anchor: إن في ذلك ( أي فيما ذكر من القصة ( لآيات ( لعلامات يستدل بها على حقيقة الحق

ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās explains al-mutawassimīn as observers.

ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r3.speaker: جعفر بن محمد
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r3.claim: Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad explains it as those who discern by insight.
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r3.anchor: وقال جعفر بن محمد رضي الله تعالى عنهما : للمتفرسين

ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r4.speaker: مجاهد
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r4.claim: Mujāhid explains it as those who take a lesson.

ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r5.claim: The reported glosses are close in meaning; al-tawassum derives from wasm, a mark from which one infers what is sought.
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r5.anchor: وقيل غير ذلك وهي معان متقاربة وفي البحر التوسم تفعل من الوسم وهو العلامة التي يستدل بها على مطلوب

ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r6.speaker: ثعلب
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r6.claim: Thaʿlab defines tawassum as looking from head to foot and thoroughly examining recognizable features.
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r6.anchor: وقال ثعلب : التوسم النظر من القرن إلى القدم واستقصاء وجوه التعريف

ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r7.claim: The word’s origin is also said to be verification and reflection, from the branding mark made with a heated iron; an idiom uses it for signs of good becoming apparent.
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r7.anchor: وذكر أن أصله التثبت والتفكر مأخوذ من الوسم وهو التأثير بحديدة محماة في جلد البعير أو غيره

ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r8.speaker: عبد الله بن رواحة
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r8.claim: Ibn Rawāḥa says he discerned goodness in the Prophet and knew it, illustrating recognition through signs.
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r8.anchor: قال عبدالله بن رواحة في رسول الله صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم

ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r9.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r9.claim: The prepositional phrase may qualify “signs” or attach to the predicate.
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r9.anchor: والجار والمجرور في موضع الصفة ( لآيات ) أو متعلق به

ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r10.speaker: السيوطي
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r10.claim: Al-Suyūṭī calls the verse a foundation for physiognomy, citing a Tirmidhī report from Abū Saʿīd attributed to the Prophet: beware a believer’s insight, for he sees by God’s light.
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r10.anchor: فقد أخرج الترمذي من حديث أبي سعيد مرفوعا اتقوا فراسة المؤمن فإنه ينظر بنور الله تعالى ثم قرأ الآية

ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r11.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r11.claim: Some Mālikīs applied physiognomy in legal judgments, following Iyās ibn Muʿāwiya.
ALUSI-FULL:v14p74#3/r11.anchor: وكان بعض المالكية يحكم بالفراسة في الأحكام جريا على طريق إياس بن معاوية

BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p388/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p388/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p388/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas interprets those who discern signs as observers.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p388/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p388/r3.speaker: مجاهد
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p388/r3.claim: Mujahid interprets them as perceptive people.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p388/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p388/r4.speaker: قتادة
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p388/r4.claim: Qatada interprets them as people who take a lesson.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p388/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p388/r5.speaker: مقاتل
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p388/r5.claim: Muqatil interprets them as reflective people.

BAYDAWI-FULL:15:75-80/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:15:75-80/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:15:75-80/r1.claim: The signs are for reflective, perceptive people who pursue observation until they recognize a thing by its mark.
BAYDAWI-FULL:15:75-80/r1.anchor: للمتفكرين المتفرسين الذين يتشبثون في نظرهم حتى يعرفوا حقيقة الشيء بسمته

SULAMI:v1p357#2/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r1.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r1.claim: The Prophet warns that a believer sees by God's light and recites the verse about discerning signs.
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r1.anchor: عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال : ' اتقوا فراسة المؤمن فإنه ينظر بنور الله

SULAMI:v1p357#2/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r2.speaker: الواسطي
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r2.claim: Wāsiṭī describes how sincerity in the movement and expression of inward secrets becomes recognizable to a discerning observer at its appointed time.
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r2.anchor: قال الواسطي : السرائر بحظوظها مصروفة عن أوقاتها صدقها في تحركها أظهر عليها صدقها في تعبرها

SULAMI:v1p357#2/r3.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r3.speaker: author
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r3.claim: He glosses those given discernment as people who scrutinize and perceive.
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r3.anchor: قال الله تعالى : ﴿ إن في ذلك لآيات للمتوسمين ﴾ قال هم : المتصفحون المتفرسون

SULAMI:v1p357#2/r4.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r4.speaker: بعضهم
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r4.claim: Discernment has three degrees: sight and hearing, intellect, and, above these, an unveiling granted to some that can disclose what is absent or present.
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r4.anchor: قال بعضهم : المتفرس على ثلاثة أوجه بالنظر والسمع ، والعقل ، وأجل من هذا حال الكشف لمن أوتيه

SULAMI:v1p357#2/r5.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r5.speaker: بعضهم
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r5.claim: To recognize people's inward realities, observe how their characters change and when their grief appears.
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r5.anchor: قال بعضهم : ^ ( المتوسمون ) ^ هم المتفرسون فإذا أردت أن تعرف بواطنهم في الحقيقة فانظر إلى تصاريف أخلاقهم ومواقيت أشجانهم

SULAMI:v1p357#2/r6.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r6.speaker: محمد بن خفيف
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r6.claim: He divides discernment into hidden states reserved for messengers, divinely disclosed inward rulings given to saints after prophets, and inspired awareness of distant unseen events, illustrated by the Prophet, Abu Bakr, and Umar; he explains the Prophet's warning as directing self-ruled people to heed those illumined by God's light.
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r6.anchor: قال محمد بن خفيف : الفراسة وقومه على ثلاثة أوجه : المكنون من الآفات المستكن في النفوس

SULAMI:v1p357#2/r7.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r7.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r7.claim: The Prophet's warning is read as telling people governed by their own souls to heed those freed from such rule and illuminated by God's light, who can see among people of darkness.
SULAMI:v1p357#2/r7.anchor: وقال : إنما حذر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بقوله ' اتقوا فراسة المؤمن طائفة هم قائمون بأحكام نفوسهم

SULAMI:v1p359/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p359/r1.speaker: بعضهم
SULAMI:v1p359/r1.claim: Discernment is the light of a spirit purified by divine holiness and a heart refined by guidance, which recognizes subtle realities deposited by God in existence.
SULAMI:v1p359/r1.anchor: قال بعضهم : صفة المتفرس من صفى الحق روحه بطهارة قدسه وذكى قلبه بأنوار هدايته

SULAMI:v1p359/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p359/r2.speaker: بعضهم
SULAMI:v1p359/r2.claim: Discernment apprehends a thing as it truly is and does not change, because one who sees through truth reports reality.
SULAMI:v1p359/r2.anchor: قال بعضهم : الفراسة إدراك الشيء على حقيقته لا يزول ولا يغير لأن الناظر إذا نظر بالحق أخبر عن حقيقة

SULAMI:v1p359/r3.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p359/r3.speaker: الحسين
SULAMI:v1p359/r3.claim: Husayn defines discernment as a truthful gaze through the Lord that reports the reality of what is seen through Him.
SULAMI:v1p359/r3.anchor: سئل الحسين عن الفراسة : فقال : حق نظر برياه فخبر عن حقيقة ما هو إياه بإياه

SULAMI:v1p359/r4.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p359/r4.speaker: أبو حفص الحداد
SULAMI:v1p359/r4.claim: Abu Hafs al-Haddad calls discernment the first thought without a counter-thought; if an equal thought opposes it, it is ordinary thought or self-talk.
SULAMI:v1p359/r4.anchor: سمعت أبا حفص الحداد يقول : الفراسة هي أول خاطر بلا معارض فإن عارض معارض من جنسه فهو خاطر ، وحديث نفسي

SULAMI:v1p359/r5.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p359/r5.speaker: أبو حفص
SULAMI:v1p359/r5.claim: No one should claim discernment for himself; one should guard against another's discernment about oneself, and he says people should not practice it on believers.
SULAMI:v1p359/r5.anchor: قال أبو حفص : ليس لأحد أن يرعى لنفسه الفراسة ، ولكن يجب أن تتقي من فراسة الغير فيه

SULAMI:v1p359/r6.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p359/r6.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
SULAMI:v1p359/r6.claim: The Prophet's reported instruction is to beware the believer's discernment; no grading is stated.
SULAMI:v1p359/r6.anchor: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال : ' اتقوا فراسة المؤمن '

SULAMI:v1p359/r7.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p359/r7.speaker: أبو عثمان
SULAMI:v1p359/r7.claim: Signs of lordship emerge in the inner secrets of the gnostics, their tongues voice them, and they meet the truth.
SULAMI:v1p359/r7.anchor: وسئل أبو عثمان عن الفراسة . فقال : آيات الربانية تظهر في أسرار العارفين

BIQAI-FULL:v4p231/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v4p231/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v4p231/r4.claim: The event offers several signs: the land was submerged after sinking, its water became foul and useless, animals could not live in it, and its appearance was dreadful.
BIQAI-FULL:v4p231/r4.anchor: من جهة غمرها بالماء بعد خسفها , ومن جهة كونه مخالفا لمياه الأرض بالنتن والخباثة , وعدم عيش الحيوان فيه

BIQAI-FULL:v4p231/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v4p231/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v4p231/r5.claim: Al-mutawassimīn are observers who read a revealing mark or trace; the signs rebuke and incite them to reflect.
BIQAI-FULL:v4p231/r5.anchor: للمتوسمين * } جمع متوسم , وهو الناظر في السمة الدالة - وهي الأثر ذلك , فهو إلهاب لهم وتبكيت

BIQAI-FULL:v4p231/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v4p231/r7.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v4p231/r7.claim: Their polluted water and ruined terrain starkly differ from the surrounding region’s fresh water, fertile soil, and trees, inviting travelers to visit, investigate, and ask what happened.
BIQAI-FULL:v4p231/r7.anchor: على كيثرتها ومع أن البلاد التي هي بها من أبهج البلاد في عذوبة المياه وطراوة الأرض وحسن الأشجار

TUSTARI:15:75/r1.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:15:75/r1.speaker: author
TUSTARI:15:75/r1.claim: The perceptive people are those who discern inward realities.

TUSTARI:15:75/r2.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:15:75/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
TUSTARI:15:75/r2.claim: Abu Sa'id reports the Prophet's warning to beware the believer's insight, because he sees by God's light; the Prophet then recited this verse.
TUSTARI:15:75/r2.anchor:
وقد روى أبو سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال:
" اتقوا فراسة المؤمن فإنه ينظر بنور الله

TUSTARI:15:75/r3.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:15:75/r3.speaker: عمر
TUSTARI:15:75/r3.claim: The author gives Umar's call to Sariya, “The mountain, the mountain,” as an instance of discerning inward realities.
TUSTARI:15:75/r3.anchor: كما قال عمر رضي الله عنه لسارية: " الجبل الجبل "

DURR-FULL:v5p90/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r7.claim: The discerning observers are those who look.
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r7.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله: {لآيات للمتوسمين} قال: للناظرين

DURR-FULL:v5p90/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r8.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r8.claim: The discerning observers are those who take a lesson.
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r8.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله: {لآيات للمتوسمين} قال: للمعتبرين

DURR-FULL:v5p90/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r9.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r9.claim: The discerning observers are people with perceptive insight.
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r9.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله: {لآيات للمتوسمين} قال: هم المتفرسون

DURR-FULL:v5p90/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r10.speaker: جعفر بن محمد
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r10.claim: Ja'far ibn Muhammad also interprets the term as people with perceptive insight.
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r10.anchor: عن جعفر بن محمد في قوله: {إن في ذلك لآيات للمتوسمين} قال: هم المتفرسون

DURR-FULL:v5p90/r11.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r11.speaker: النبي
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r11.claim: The Prophet warns that a believer's insight sees by God's light, then interprets the verse's observers as those with discernment.
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r11.anchor: عن أبي سعيد الخدري قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: اتقوا فراسة المؤمن فإنه ينظر بنور الله

DURR-FULL:v5p90/r12.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r12.speaker: النبي
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r12.claim: The Prophet says a believer's insight sees by God's light.
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r12.anchor: عن ابن عمر قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: اتقوا فراسة المؤمن فإن المؤمن ينظر بنور الله

DURR-FULL:v5p90/r13.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r13.speaker: النبي
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r13.claim: The Prophet says a believer's insight sees by God's light and speaks through God's enabling.
DURR-FULL:v5p90/r13.anchor: عن ثوبان قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم احذروا فراسة المؤمن فإنه ينظر بنور الله وينطق بتوفيق الله

IBNASHUR-FULL:v14p68/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v14p68/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v14p68/r9.claim: The statement about signs for discerning people is a concluding summary: the story supplies evidence about guidance and its opposite and about the severe punishment of those who deny messengers.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v14p68/r9.anchor: وجملة { إن في ذلك لأيات للمتوسمين } : تذييل . والآيات : الأدلة ، أي دلائل على حقائق من الهداية وضدها ، وعلى تعرض المكذبين رسلهم لعقاب شديد .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v14p68/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v14p68/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v14p68/r10.claim: ‘That’ refers to the whole account beginning at 15:51: the angels’ honor to Abraham and news of a learned son, their warning about Lot’s people, aid and rescue for Lot and his family, destruction of his people and wife for siding with them, blindness to repentance’s signs, and divine anger at persistent defiance.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v14p68/r10.anchor: والإشارة { في ذلك } إلى جميع ما تضمنته القصة المبدوءة بقوله تعالى : { ونبئهم عن ضيف إبراهيم ( سورة الحجر : 51 ) . ففيها من الآيات آية نزول الملائكة في بيت إبراهيم عليه السلام كرامة له

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p371/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p371/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p371/r2.claim: Āya means a sign or marker, as in the expression ‘a sign between me and you.’
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p371/r2.anchor: وقوله الآية أي أمارة وعلامة كما تقول آية ما بيني وبينك كذا وكذا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r1.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r1.claim: A report from Abu Saʿid al-Khudri says the Prophet urged believers’ insight, recited the verse, and explained al-mutawassimin as the perceptive.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r1.anchor: روى أبو سعيد الخدري عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال اتقوا فراسه المؤمن فإنه ينظر بنور الله

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r2.speaker: مجاهد وابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r2.claim: Mujahid and Ibn Qutayba also gloss al-mutawassimin as those who discern by insight.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r2.anchor: قال المتفرسين وبهذا قال مجاهد وابن قتيبة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r3.speaker: ابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r3.claim: Ibn Qutayba explains the verb tawassama as recognizing a quality in someone.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r3.anchor: قال ابن قتيبة يقال توسمت في فلان الخير أي تبينته

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r4.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r4.claim: Al-Zajjaj defines the term as observers who carefully verify a thing’s identifying mark until they know its reality.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r4.anchor: وقال الزجاج المتوسمون في اللغة النظار المتثبتون في نظرهم حتى يعرفوا حقيقة سمة الشيء

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r5.speaker: غيره
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r5.claim: Another lexicographer defines a mutawassim as one who looks at a sign that points to something.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r5.anchor: وقال غيره المتوسم الناظر في السمة الدالة على الشيء

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r6.speaker: قتادة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r6.claim: Qatada interprets al-mutawassimin as those who take a lesson.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r8.speaker: ابن زيد والفراء
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r8.claim: Ibn Zayd and al-Farraʾ interpret al-mutawassimin as reflective people.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v4p409#3/r8.anchor: والرابع المتفكرون قاله ابن زيد والفراء

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r3.claim: The visible traces of the punishment are signs for those who consider them carefully with sight and insight.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r3.anchor: على تلك البلاد لمن تأمل ذلك وتوسمه بعين بصره وبصيرته

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r4.speaker: مجاهد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r4.claim: Mujahid glosses those who read the signs as people of discernment.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r4.anchor: كما قال مجاهد في قوله: {للمتوسمين} قال: المتفرسين.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r5.speaker: ابن عباس، والضحاك
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r5.claim: Ibn Abbas and al-Dahhak interpret the term as referring to onlookers.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r6.speaker: قتادة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r6.claim: Qatada interprets the term as people who take a lesson.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r7.speaker: مالك عن بعض أهل المدينة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r7.claim: Malik transmits from some people of Medina that the term means those who reflect.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r7.anchor: وقال مالك عن بعض أهل المدينة: {للمتوسمين} للمتأملين.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r8.speaker: النبي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r8.claim: Abu Sa'id reports the Prophet's warning to beware the believer's discernment, since he sees by God's light; al-Tirmidhi says this report is known only by this route.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r8.anchor: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم "اتقوا فراسة المؤمن، فإنه ينظر بنور الله"

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r9.speaker: النبي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r9.claim: Ibn Umar reports the Prophet saying that believers see by God's light.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r9.anchor: عن ابن عمر قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "اتقوا فراسة المؤمن؛ فإن المؤمن ينظر (5) بنور الله"

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r10.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r10.speaker: النبي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r10.claim: Thawban reports the Prophet's warning to beware a believer's discernment, since he sees by God's light and speaks by God's enabling.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r10.anchor: عن ثوبان قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "احذروا فراسة المؤمن؛ فإنه ينظر بنور الله وينطق بتوفيق الله"

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r11.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r11.speaker: النبي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r11.claim: Anas reports the Prophet saying that God has servants who recognize people through discernment.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p543/r11.anchor: عن أنس بن مالك قال: قال النبي (8) صلى الله عليه وسلم: "إن لله عبادا يعرفون الناس بالتوسم"

JISHUMI:v6p3969/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p3969/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v6p3969/r8.claim: Mutawassim is someone who looks for an identifying mark; wasm is marking, al-wasmī is the first rain that marks the land with vegetation, and tawassum is seeking its signs.
JISHUMI:v6p3969/r8.anchor: المتوسم: الناظر في السمة الدالة وهي. العلامة، يقال: وسمت الشيء وسما إذا أثرت فيه سمة، ومنه: الوسمي أول المطر؛ لأنه يسم الأرض بالنبات

JISHUMI:v6p3969/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p3969/r9.speaker: الشاعر
JISHUMI:v6p3969/r9.claim: An unnamed poet's line uses mutawassim for someone marked by a spear thrust; dom refers to a tree.
JISHUMI:v6p3969/r9.anchor: قال الشاعر: وأصبحن كالدوم النواعم غدوة ... على وجهه من طاعن متوسم الدوم: شجرة

JISHUMI:v6p3973/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p3973/r1.speaker: الحسن، وقتادة، والضحاك، ومجاهد
JISHUMI:v6p3973/r1.claim: The signs and the settled route are clear to people who have seen the remains and heard the reports about Lot's people.
JISHUMI:v6p3973/r1.anchor: شاهد فسمع الأخبار، عن الحسن، وقتادة، والضحاك، ومجاهد.

JISHUMI:v6p3973/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p3973/r2.speaker: الأصم، وأبو علي
JISHUMI:v6p3973/r2.claim: Alternatively, the signs are known and enduring.
JISHUMI:v6p3973/r2.anchor: وقيل: تلك الآيات معلومة قائمة، عن الأصم، وأبي علي

JISHUMI:v6p3973/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p3973/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v6p3973/r8.claim: The verses show that Lot's people were destroyed and the believing members of his household were saved.
JISHUMI:v6p3973/r8.anchor: تدل الآية على إهلاك قوم لوط ونجاة من آمن من أهله

JISHUMI:v6p3973/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p3973/r9.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v6p3973/r9.claim: The signs for perceptive people make reflection obligatory because reflection draws one toward truth and restrains falsehood.
JISHUMI:v6p3973/r9.anchor: ويدل قوله: (لآيات للمتوسمين) على وجوب النظر، لأن النظر فيها يحث على الحق، ويزجر عن الباطل

JISHUMI:v6p3973/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p3973/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v6p3973/r10.claim: The remains endure so people can learn from them, and they provide divine لطف for us.
JISHUMI:v6p3973/r10.anchor: وتدل على أن آثارها باقية ليعتبر بها، وأن فيها لطف لنا

KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p547/r18.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p547/r18.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p547/r18.claim: The discerning are perceptive observers who examine carefully until they recognize the reality marked by a thing; the verb means recognizing its sign in someone.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p547/r18.anchor: للمتفرسين المتأملين . وحقيقة المتوسمين النظار المتثبتون في نظرهم حتى يعرفوا حقيقة سمة الشيء

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r1.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r1.claim: Al-mutawassimīn are people who read signs through physiognomy.

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r2.speaker: النبي
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r2.claim: A prophetic report urges believers to beware a believer's insight, since he sees by God's light, then recites this verse.
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r2.anchor: وروي عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال : ( اتقوا فراسة المؤمن فإنه ينظر بنور الله ) ثم تلا هذه الآية .

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r3.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r3.claim: They are people who take admonition from what they see.

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r6.speaker: زهير بن أبي سلمى
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r6.claim: Zuhayr's line uses mutawassim for a viewer who takes in an elegant spectacle.
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r6.anchor: قال زهير بن أبي سلمى : وفيهن ملهى للصديق ومنظر … أنيق لعين الناظر المتوسم

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r7.speaker: أبو عبيدة
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r7.claim: They are people who see clearly.

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r8.speaker: الحسن
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r8.claim: Hasan says they infer that the One who destroyed Lot's people can also destroy unbelievers.
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r8.anchor: قال الحسن : هم الذين يتوسمون الأمور فيعلمون أن الذي أهلك قوم لوط قادر على أن يهلك الكفار ,

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r9.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r9.speaker: عبدالله بن رواحة
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r9.claim: Ibn Rawaha tells the Prophet that he perceived goodness in him and knew it with steady insight.
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p166/r9.anchor: ومنه قول عبدالله بن رواحة للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : إني توسمت فيك الخير أعرفه … والله يعلم أني ثابت البصر

MUQATIL:15:74-77/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:15:74-77/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:15:74-77/r3.claim: The destruction of Lot's people is a lesson for later observers, who should beware receiving a like punishment.
MUQATIL:15:74-77/r3.anchor: يقول: للناظرين من بعدهم، فيحذرون مثل عقوبتهم

NASAFI-FULL:v2p246#2/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p246#2/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v2p246#2/r1.claim: The perceptive are contemplative observers who seem to recognize what is hidden from an outward mark.
NASAFI-FULL:v2p246#2/r1.anchor: للمتفرسين المتأملين كأنهم يعرفون باطن الشيء بسمة ظاهرة

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r1.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r1.claim: A report from Abu Saʿid gives “for the perceptive”; al-Qurtubi identifies this as Mujahid’s interpretation.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r1.anchor: من حديث أبي سعيد الخدري عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r2.claim: The Prophet says to beware a believer’s insight, for he sees by God’s light, then recites this verse; al-Tirmidhi calls the report unusual.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r2.anchor: اتقوا فراسة المؤمن فإنه ينظر بنور الله

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r3.speaker: مقاتل، ابن زيد
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r3.claim: They interpret mutawassimin as people who reflect.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r3.anchor: وقال مقاتل وابن زيد: للمتوسمين للمتفكرين.

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r4.speaker: الضحاك
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r4.claim: He interprets the word as those who look or observe.

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r5.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r5.claim: He interprets them as people who take a lesson.

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r6.speaker: أبو عبيدة
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r6.claim: He glosses the word as people who see clearly; the meanings are close.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r6.anchor: وقال أبو عبيدة: للمتبصرين، والمعنى متقارب.

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r7.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r7.claim: The word derives from wasm, a sign used to infer something sought; to perceive goodness in someone is to notice its mark.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r7.anchor: قال العلماء: التوسم تفعل من الوسم، وهي العلامة التي يستدل بها على مطلوب غيرها.

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r8.speaker: ثعلب
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r8.claim: He defines al-wāsim as an observer who looks over a person from head to foot.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r8.anchor: وقال ثعلب: الواسم الناظر إليك من فرقك إلى قدمك.

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r9.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r9.claim: The root suggests careful reflection and discernment, like branding that leaves an imprint.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r9.anchor: وأصل التوسم التثبت والتفكر مأخوذ من الوسم وهو التأثير بحديدة في جلد البعير وغيره

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r10.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r10.claim: Others add that insight requires clearing the heart of worldly distractions, sins, corrupt character, and excess.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r10.anchor: زاد غيره: وتفريغ القلب من حشو الدنيا، وتطهيره من أدناس المعاصي وكدورة الأخلاق وفضول الدنيا.

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r11.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r11.claim: Through Nahshal, he is reported to interpret the perceptive as people of righteousness and goodness.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r11.anchor: روى نهشل عن ابن عباس «للمتوسمين» قال: لأهل الصلاح والخير.

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r12.speaker: الصوفية
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r12.claim: Sufis classify this insight as a miracle or charism; another view explains it as deduction from signs, some obvious and others subtle.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r12.anchor: وزعمت الصوفية أنها كرامة. وقيل: بل هي استدلال بالعلامات، ومن العلامات ما يبدو ظاهرا لكل أحد

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r13.speaker: الحسن
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r13.claim: He says perceptive people infer that the God who destroyed Lot’s people can also destroy the unbelievers.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r13.anchor: قال الحسن: المتوسمون هم الذين يتوسمون الأمور فيعلمون أن الذي أهلك قوم لوط قادر على أن يهلك الكفار

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r14.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r14.claim: He says he could tell whether a questioner was a jurist.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r14.anchor: ومثله قول ابن عباس: ما سألني أحد عن شيء إلا عرفت أفقيه هو أو غير فقيه.

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r15.speaker: الشعراء
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75/r15.claim: Poets cited by al-Qurtubi use tawassum for recognizing a visitor’s nature or for noticing a perceiving observer.

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r1.speaker: جندب بن عبد الله البجلي
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r1.claim: He predicted that a Quran reciter who sought reputation would become a Kharijite leader; the man, Mirdas, did so.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r1.anchor: فقلنا له: كأنك عرضت بهذا الرجل، فقال: إن هذا يقرأ عليك القرآن اليوم ويخرج غدا حروريا فكان رأس الحرورية، واسمه مرداس

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r2.speaker: الحسن البصري
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r2.claim: He called ʿAmr ibn ʿUbayd Basra’s finest young man unless he changed; ʿAmr’s Qadarite views later alienated many companions.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r2.anchor: وروي عن الحسن البصري أنه دخل عليه عمرو بن عبيد فقال: هذا سيد فتيان البصرة إن لم يحدث

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r3.speaker: الحسن البصري
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r3.claim: He separately praised Ayyub as the best young man of Basra without adding a qualification.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r3.anchor: وقال لأيوب: هذا سيد فتيان أهل البصرة، ولم يستثن.

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r4.speaker: الشعبي
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r4.claim: He predicted that Dawud al-Azdi would die after being cauterized on the head, and the prediction came true.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r4.anchor: وروي عن الشعبي أنه قال لداود الأزدي وهو يماريه: إنك لا تموت حتى تكوى في رأسك، وكان كذلك.

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r5.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r5.claim: After observing Malik al-Ashtar, Umar predicted that he would bring Muslims a grave day; Malik later played a role in the civil strife.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r5.anchor: فقال: ما له قاتله الله! إني لأرى للمسلمين منه يوما عصيبا فكان منه في الفتنة ما كان.

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r6.speaker: عثمان بن عفان
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r6.claim: When Anas entered after looking at a woman in the market, Uthman said evidence of fornication showed in his eye; he called it insight, proof, and truthfulness, not revelation.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r6.anchor: قال عثمان: يدخل أحدكم علي وفي عينيه أثر الزنى! فقال له أنس: أوحيا بعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم؟

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r7.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r7.claim: Even if intuitive perception reveals meanings, it cannot ground legal rulings or judgments against a person; legal evidence must be established by sacred law.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r7.anchor: إذا ثبت أن التوسم والتفرس من مدارك المعاني فإن ذلك لا يترتب عليه حكم

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r8.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r8.claim: He recounts that a Baghdad chief judge ruled by intuition after the example of Iyas ibn Muʿawiya, but his teacher al-Shashi wrote a rebuttal.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r8.anchor: يحكم بالفراسة في الأحكام، جريا على طريق إياس بن معاوية

QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r9.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r9.claim: Al-Qurtubi presents the legal objection as sound: intuitive insight is not among the categorical, legally recognized means of judgment.
QURTUBI-FULL:15:75#2/r9.anchor: وذلك صحيح فإن مدارك الأحكام معلومة شرعا مدركة قطعا وليست الفراسة منها.

RAZI-FULL:v19p161/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v19p161/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v19p161/r5.claim: Exegetes explain mutawassimin as those who discern, look, contemplate, take warning, or see clearly.
RAZI-FULL:v19p161/r5.anchor: واختلفت عبارات المفسرين في تفسير المتوسمين قيل : المتفرسين ، وقيل : الناظرين

RAZI-FULL:v19p161/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v19p161/r6.speaker: الزجاج
RAZI-FULL:v19p161/r6.claim: Al-Zajjāj says the word's linguistic sense is to examine steadily until one recognizes a thing's mark, quality, or sign.
RAZI-FULL:v19p161/r6.anchor: قال الزجاج : حقيقة المتوسمين في اللغة المتثبتون في نظرهم حتى يعرفوا

STUDYQURAN:15:75/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:15:75/r1.speaker: Z
STUDYQURAN:15:75/r1.claim: Those who discern are people of deep reflection who recognize the reality behind outward forms, or simah.

SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r1.claim: للمتوسمين may modify an omitted noun as an adjective of signs, but best attaches directly to آيات because that word means signs.
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r1.anchor: والأجود أن يتعلق بنفس " آيات " لأنها بمعنى العلامات.

SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r2.claim: Tawassum is derived from wasm; the root sense is careful reflection, associated with marking an animal with a heated iron.
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r2.anchor: والتوسم تفعل من الوسم، والوسم: أصله التثبت والتفكر، مأخوذ من الوسم، وهو التأثير بحديدة

SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r3.speaker: ثعلب
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r3.claim: He defines a wasim as someone who looks a person over from head to toe, implying careful scrutiny.
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r3.anchor: وقال ثعلب: " الواسم: الناظر إليك من قرنك إلى قدمك " ، وفيه معنى التثبت.

SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r4.speaker: قيل
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r4.claim: Another derivation is exhaustive identification; a cited anonymous line uses يتوسم for such recognition.
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r4.anchor: وقيل:/ أصله: استقصاء التعرف يقال: توسمت، أي: تعرفت مستقصيا وجوه التعرف.

SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r5.speaker: آخر
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r5.claim: The cited line about a tribe arriving at ʿUkāẓ witnesses the verb يتوسم in the sense of identifying people.
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r5.anchor: أو كلما وردت عكاظ قبيلة بعثت إلي عريفها يتوسم

SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r6.speaker: قيل
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r6.claim: A further derivation takes it from wasm, a mark or sign: seeing good's mark in someone is to recognize good in them.
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r6.anchor: وقيل: هو تفعل من الوسم، وهو العلامة: توسمت فيك خيرا، أي: ظهر له ميسمه عليك.

SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r7.speaker: ابن رواحة
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r7.claim: His poem about the Prophet witnesses the phrase توسمت فيك الخير as recognizing goodness in a person.
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r7.anchor:
قال ابن رواحة في النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم:
2950- إني توسمت فيك الخير أعرفه

SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r8.speaker: آخر
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r8.claim: Another cited poem describes recognizing a man's lineage from his dignified bearing.
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r8.anchor:
وقال آخر:
2951- توسمته لما رأيت مهابة

SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r9.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r9.claim: اتسم means adopting a distinguishing mark; توسّم can also mean seeking spring pasture that grows after the first rain.
SAMIN-DURR:15:75/r9.anchor: ويقال: اتسم الرجل: إذا اتخذ لنفسه علامة يعرف بها، وتوسم: إذا طلب كلأ الوسمي

TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r1.claim: Al-Tabari calls Lot’s people’s destruction a lesson and applies it to Quraysh, who should learn from their denial of their messenger and persistence in error.
TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r1.anchor: فلقومك يا محمد في قوم لوط، وما حل بهم من عذاب الله حين كذبوا رسولهم وتمادوا في غيهم وضلالهم، معتبر

TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r2.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r2.claim: Mujahid glosses al-mutawassimin as perceptive people and gives “I discerned good in you as a gift” as an example.
TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r2.anchor: عن ابن جريج، عن مجاهد قال: " المتوسمين: المتفرسين قال: توسمت فيك الخير نافلة "

TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses al-mutawassimin as observers.
TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس: {إن في ذلك لآيات للمتوسمين} [الحجر: 75] يقول: «للناظرين»

TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r5.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r5.claim: Qatada says the signs are for those who take heed.
TAB-FULL:v14p94#2/r5.anchor: عن قتادة: " {إن في ذلك لآيات للمتوسمين} [الحجر: 75] أي للمعتبرين "

TAB-FULL:v14p97/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r1.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r1.claim: In a report from Abu Saʿid, the Prophet warns of the believer’s discernment, saying the believer sees by God’s light.
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r1.anchor: عن أبي سعيد، قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «اتقوا فراسة المؤمن؛ فإنه ينظر بنور الله»

TAB-FULL:v14p97/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r2.claim: In a report from Ibn ʿUmar, the Prophet likewise says that the believer sees by God’s light.
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r2.anchor: عن ابن عمر، قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «اتقوا فراسة المؤمن؛ فإن المؤمن ينظر بنور الله»

TAB-FULL:v14p97/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r3.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r3.claim: In a report from Anas, the Prophet says God has servants who recognize people through discernment.
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r3.anchor: عن أنس، قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إن لله عبادا يعرفون الناس بالتوسم»

TAB-FULL:v14p97/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r4.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r4.claim: Ibn Zayd describes the perceptive as people who reflect on what they discern and learn lessons from it.
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r4.anchor: قال ابن زيد، في قوله: {إن في ذلك لآيات للمتوسمين} [الحجر: 75] قال: «المتفكرون والمعتبرون الذين يتوسمون الأشياء

TAB-FULL:v14p97/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r5.speaker: الضحاك
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r5.anchor: سمعت الضحاك يقول في قوله: {للمتوسمين} [الحجر: 75] يقول: «للناظرين»

TAB-FULL:v14p97/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r6.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r6.claim: In a report from Thawban, the Prophet warns of the believer’s discernment: the believer sees by God’s light and speaks by God’s enabling.
TAB-FULL:v14p97/r6.anchor: عن ثوبان، قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «احذروا فراسة المؤمن؛ فإنه ينظر بنور الله، وينطق بتوفيق الله»

ZAJJAJ:v3p184/r2.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v3p184/r2.speaker: قيل
ZAJJAJ:v3p184/r2.claim: One gloss takes al-mutawassimīn as people with discernment or insight.

ZAJJAJ:v3p184/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v3p184/r3.speaker: قيل
ZAJJAJ:v3p184/r3.claim: Another gloss takes al-mutawassimīn as people who reflect.

ZAJJAJ:v3p184/r4.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v3p184/r4.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v3p184/r4.claim: Literally they are observers who examine carefully until recognizing a thing’s true mark; tawassamtu fī fulān means recognizing its sign in him.
ZAJJAJ:v3p184/r4.anchor: وحقيقته في اللغة المتوسمون النظار المتثبتون في نظرهم حتى يعرفوا حقيقة سمة الشيء

THALABI:v5p345/r16.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v5p345/r16.speaker: ابن عباس والضحاك
THALABI:v5p345/r16.claim: Ibn Abbas and al-Dahhak explain the perceptive observers as onlookers.

THALABI:v5p345/r17.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v5p345/r17.speaker: مجاهد
THALABI:v5p345/r17.claim: Mujahid says the observers are those who discern signs perceptively.
THALABI:v5p345/r17.anchor: مجاهد: للمتفرسين. قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم:

THALABI:v5p345/r18.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v5p345/r18.speaker: النبي ﷺ
THALABI:v5p345/r18.claim: The Prophet says to beware a believer’s insight because he sees by God’s light, then recites this verse.
THALABI:v5p345/r18.anchor: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «اتقوا فراسة المؤمن فإنه ينظر بنور الله» ثم قرأ هذه الآية

THALABI:v5p345/r19.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v5p345/r19.speaker: قتادة
THALABI:v5p345/r19.claim: Qatadah explains the perceptive observers as those who take a lesson.

THALABI:v5p345/r20.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v5p345/r20.speaker: شاعر مجهول
THALABI:v5p345/r20.claim: An anonymous poet uses tawassum for discerning a man’s lineage from his imposing appearance.
THALABI:v5p345/r20.anchor: وقال الشاعر: توسمته لما رأيت مهابة … عليه وقلت المرء من آل هاشم

THALABI:v5p345/r21.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v5p345/r21.speaker: شاعر آخر
THALABI:v5p345/r21.claim: A second poet describes a tribe sending its ʿarīf to inspect and recognize each incoming group.
THALABI:v5p345/r21.anchor: وقال آخر: أو كلما وردت عكاظ قبيلة … بعثوا إلي عريفهم يتوسم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r1.claim: The root sense of توسم is to see a trace of good in someone or discern good in them by observation.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r1.anchor: يقال: توسمت في فلان خيرا، إذا رأيت فيه أثرا منه

WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r2.claim: In ʿAṭāʾ's transmission, المتوسمين means people with discernment; Mujāhid, al-Farrāʾ, al-Zajjāj, and Ibn Qutayba agree.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r2.anchor: قال ابن عباس في رواية عطاء: للمتفرسين

WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r3.speaker: الضحاك
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r3.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk interprets the term as onlookers.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r4.speaker: مقاتل وابن زيد
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r4.claim: Muqātil and Ibn Zayd interpret the term as reflective people.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r5.speaker: قتادة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r5.claim: Qatāda interprets the term as people who take a lesson.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r6.speaker: أبو عبيدة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r6.claim: Abū ʿUbayda glosses the term as perceptive observers and cites a line by Zuhayr using المتوسم of an observant viewer.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r6.anchor: أنشد لزهير: وفيهن ملهى للطيف ومنظر ... أنيق لعين الناظر المتوسم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r7.speaker: أبو إسحاق
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r7.claim: In its precise lexical sense, a mutawassim scrutinizes a mark until its true signification is known; one recognizes a quality in someone by looking.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v12p637#2/r7.anchor: وحقيقته في اللغة؛ المتوسمون النظار المتثبتون في نظرهم حتى يعرفوا حقيقة سمة الشيء

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:15:75-81/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:15:75-81/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:15:75-81/r1.claim: The discerning are those who carefully and persistently observe until they recognize the true mark of a thing.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:15:75-81/r1.anchor: أي: المتفرسين المتثبتين في النظر حتى يعرفوا حقيقة سمة الشيء

BURHAN:v4p13/r10.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p13/r10.speaker: author
BURHAN:v4p13/r10.claim: Plural verses indicate multiple proofs, while a singular sign reflects the oneness of what is being demonstrated.
BURHAN:v4p13/r10.anchor: فحيث جمعت فلجمع الدلائل وحيث وحدت فلوحدانية المدلول عليه

BURHAN:v4p13/r11.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p13/r11.speaker: author
BURHAN:v4p13/r11.claim: The plural in the verse for those who discern contrasts with the singular sign for believers, whose quality is described by divine oneness.
BURHAN:v4p13/r11.anchor: فلما ذكر صفة المؤمنين بالوحدانية وحد الآية

DURR-FULL:v5p91/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p91/r1.speaker: أنس
DURR-FULL:v5p91/r1.claim: Anas reports the Prophet saying that God has servants who recognize people by discernment (tawassum).
DURR-FULL:v5p91/r1.anchor: عن أنس قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: إن لله عبادا يعرفون الناس بالتوسم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p370/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p370/r10.speaker: مجاهد
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p370/r10.claim: Mujahid glosses al-mutawassimin as perceptive observers.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p370/r10.anchor: قال مجاهد المتفرسون، وقال الضحاك الناظرون، وقال قتادة المعتبرون

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p370/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p370/r11.speaker: الضحاك
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p370/r11.anchor: وقال الضحاك الناظرون، وقال قتادة المعتبرون

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p370/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p370/r12.speaker: قتادة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p370/r12.claim: Qatada glosses al-mutawassimin as people who take warning.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p370/r12.anchor: وقال قتادة المعتبرون، وقيل غير هذا مما هو قريب منه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p370/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p370/r13.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p370/r13.claim: The word refers to one who studies visible marks that reveal qualities; the destruction left a sign from which observers can infer sin and avoid their fate. Ibn Atiyya cites poetry using the root for discerning.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p370/r13.anchor: فالمتوسم هو الذي ينظر في وسم المعنى فيستدل به على المعنى

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p544/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p544/r1.speaker: أنس عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p544/r1.claim: Al-Bazzar transmits from Anas that God has servants who recognize people by physiognomy; the source calls Abu Bishr, Ibn al-Muzallaq, reliable.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p544/r1.anchor: عن أنس قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "إن لله عبادا يعرفون الناس بالتوسم"
